notes.title: BRAND!! NEW!! GAME!! / 新游戏！
notes.content:
So I guess we just don't have to talk much here:
哎呀呀，转眼也到了最适合发布这款游戏的时候了呢：
http://store.steampowered.com/app/757180/Wolf__Rabbit/

A little cute RPG which grants an about-3-hour gameplay, and it's cheap!
话说回来这定价……某组怕是真的只能陪杯子孭织一起吃土了啊……
But why its developers are not entitled as LR? Well, good question...
捎带一提之后无色之黑会偷偷更新，至于告白日会不会……
Maybe I can ask those two dumplings about this once more just for fun...
……嗯，还是等制作组把之后预定要用的几个名字都用完了以后再说吧。

——dspzzy

notes.title: We just released an update, as well as a new game.
notes.content:
Improved English translation, maybe. That's not the point though.
(Thank to Joe P. for his efforts!)
The new game has nothing to do with this game. Yes, trust me.
某些不重要的小更新以及顺便宣传新作啦。请相信这和告白日没什么关系啦。
→http://store.steampowered.com/app/687830/Transparent_Black/
